facts.identityBasis: The official developer release names the east hill at Nawayef on Hudayriyat Island and explicitly limits the initial sales release to Homes and Heights types 5–8, with other Heights and Mansions to follow.
facts.note: The initial release population is explicit. It does not establish the launch date of later Heights types, Mansions, construction, completion or registered sales.

collection.method: Bounded exact-identity review of five public Modon pages over certificate-validated HTTPS with a two-megabyte response cap and SHA-256 capture; three sources contributed non-duplicate evidence and two redundant exact releases remained only in private scratch review

methodology: Add current exact-subject advertisements, current planned handover targets and an explicitly bounded initial release phase. Retain TBC as missing rather than numeric. Do not infer construction start from a contract, divide a combined East/West contract value, replace observed history with advertisements, or create forecast values.
